messages.text:
Ivo can reserve 50 design days for **$42,500** if Hearth guarantees the full block and pays a 30% deposit within five business days of signing. If Hearth needs flexibility on the day count, Ivo can work at $900 per day, with dates reserved for the block Hearth commits to.

The fixed fee covers concept design, accessible layouts and visitor interactions, and a design package for handoff to the fabricator. Hearth would provide one consolidated set of comments at concept review and one at detailed design review. Both revision rounds are included. Additional revisions or scope changes would need written approval at $900 per day.

For the guaranteed block, we propose $12,750 at signing, $17,000 on delivery of the concept package, and $12,750 on delivery of the final design package. The two delivery invoices would be payable within 15 days. Fabrication supervision would be a separate engagement at $900 per day, with dates agreed in advance. Ivo would retain permission to show cleared photographs of the exhibit in their portfolio after the public opening.

Can Hearth commit to the 50-day block and deposit timing? Please send the fabrication-slot deadline, the date the fabricator needs the design package, and any anticipated supervision dates so Ivo can confirm the schedule.

Thank you for the quote. A few points before we can commit:

**Fee and day count.** $42,500 for 50 days works within our budget, but our funding terms limit the deposit to 20% ($8,500), not 30%. If Ivo needs a larger first payment, we could instead structure it as 20% at signing plus a slightly larger first milestone, but 30% up front isn't something we can sign.

**Payment structure.** Our grant requires deposit plus three milestone payments. Your proposal has two delivery milestones — we'd ask for three: e.g., $8,500 at signing, $12,750 on concept package, $12,750 on detailed design approval, $8,500 on final fabricator-ready package. Same total, same net timing, just split differently for compliance.

**Design package.** To be acceptable, the final package must include fully editable native fabrication files (CAD/vector, not flattened PDFs) and the accessible alternate layout must be a delivered, documented layout — not just consultation notes. Please confirm both are inside the $42,500.

**Schedule.** We can guarantee a 46-day block rather than 50, since some museum-side review time sits outside Ivo's desk days. If Ivo needs the full 50 committed, we'd instead ask that the extra 4 days be held as contingency and billed only if used. The fabricator needs the final package by **[slot date]** — I'll confirm the exact date with the fabricator and send it, along with target review dates, once you confirm the payment split. There's no on-site installation supervision in this engagement; we'd price that separately later if needed.

**Photographs.** Our sponsor restricts photography until the first touring venue opens, roughly two months after our launch. So portfolio use of exhibit photos must be deferred until that touring opening, not our public opening. Cleared photos only, and we'd ask that venue-identifying shots wait for venue approval too.

If you can accept the 20% deposit, the three-milestone split, editable files, and the deferred photo rights, we're ready to paper this quickly so the fabrication slot isn't at risk.

Ivo can accept the 20% deposit and three milestones. At **$42,500 for 50 guaranteed design days**, the proposed split works: $8,500 within five business days of signing, $12,750 on concept delivery, $12,750 on detailed design approval, and $8,500 on final handoff. Milestone invoices are due within 15 days. Hearth can reserve the last four days for contingency within that fixed fee.

If Hearth can guarantee **46 days**, Ivo can offer **$39,100** for that block at the same discounted rate of $850 per day. The payments would be $7,820, $11,730, $11,730, and $7,820 on the same terms. Hearth could authorize up to four additional days in writing at $850 each, billed only if used, bringing the maximum to $42,500. Let’s identify the contingency dates and a release date when we set the schedule. Museum review time does not count as design days.

Both options include editable native CAD/vector fabrication files and a documented accessible alternate layout. Please send the fabricator’s preferred file formats and versions so Ivo can deliver files the shop can edit directly. The fee includes one consolidated revision round at concept review and one at detailed design review. Additional revisions require written authorization at $900 per day. Fabrication or installation supervision would require a separate agreement and dates confirmed in advance.

Ivo accepts the photo embargo through the first touring venue’s public opening. After that opening, Ivo may use cleared exhibit photographs in their portfolio, with venue approval for shots that identify the venue.

Please confirm which block Hearth prefers and send the fabrication deadline and target review dates, including a date for detailed design approval. With those dates, Ivo can confirm the handoff schedule for the agreement.

We'll take the **46-day block at $39,100**, with the contingency option of up to four additional days at $850 each, authorized in writing and billed only if used, capped at $42,500. The four-way split ($7,820 / $11,730 / $11,730 / $7,820) works for our grant terms, as does the 15-day invoice window.

**Schedule.** The fabricator's slot requires the final design package no later than **Friday of week 16 from signing**. Working back from that, and leaving two weeks for our fabricator intake questions:

- **Concept package delivery: end of week 5**
- **Concept review and consolidated comments: week 6** (museum turnaround within 5 business days of delivery)
- **Detailed design package delivery: end of week 10**
- **Detailed design approval: week 11** (again 5 business days for our comments)
- **Final package with editable files: end of week 14**, leaving two weeks of buffer before the slot deadline
- **Contingency days, if authorized: weeks 15–16**

That front-loads your desk days; the middle of the schedule is museum review time and doesn't count against the 46.

**File formats.** Our fabricator wants native **DXF** and **STEP** for fabrication geometry, plus **AI or layered PDF** for graphics, in current versions. Please confirm Ivo can deliver in those formats and that any specialist software handoff (e.g., for the accessible alternate layout) will include editable source files, not exports.

**Two additions before we finalize:**

1. **Design days definition.** Please confirm the 46 days are business days and that the schedule above is feasible within them, so we're aligned before signing.
2. **Photo rights language.** We'd like the agreement to state the embargo lifts at the **first touring venue's public opening** (anticipated ~two months after our launch) and that Ivo will seek venue approval for venue-identifying shots — consistent with what you proposed.

With those confirmed, we're prepared to sign and issue the deposit within five business days.

Ivo accepts the **46-business-day block at $39,100** and can meet the proposed schedule. The 46 days are Ivo’s design workdays. Hearth’s review time falls outside that count.

Ivo will deliver the concept package by the end of week 5, the detailed design package by the end of week 10, and the final fabricator-ready package by the end of week 14. The schedule relies on Hearth returning consolidated comments within five business days at each review and confirming detailed design approval in week 11. One revision round is included at each review. The week 14 handoff leaves two weeks before the fabricator’s **Friday of week 16** deadline.

The fee includes editable **DXF and STEP** fabrication geometry, **AI** files for graphics, and a documented accessible alternate layout with its editable specialist source files. Ivo will confirm compatible file versions with the fabricator at kickoff.

The **$7,820 deposit** is due within five business days of signing. The remaining payments are $11,730 on concept delivery, $11,730 on detailed design approval, and $7,820 on final handoff, each payable within 15 days. Ivo will hold up to four contingency days in weeks 15–16 for intake questions or follow-up design work. Those days require advance written authorization and are billed only if used at $850 per day, capping the block plus contingency at **$42,500**. Additional revision rounds require separate written authorization at $900 per day. Fabrication or installation supervision requires a separate agreement with dates set in advance.

Ivo may use cleared exhibit photographs in their portfolio once the **first touring venue opens to the public**. Ivo will obtain the venue’s approval before using any photograph that identifies it.

Ivo is ready to sign on these terms.

Confirmed. We're aligned on all terms:

- **Scope:** 46 design days at $39,100; concept, detailed, and final fabricator-ready packages including editable DXF/STEP geometry, AI graphics files, and the documented accessible alternate layout with editable source files.
- **Payments:** $7,820 deposit within five business days of signing; $11,730 at concept delivery; $11,730 at detailed design approval (week 11); $7,820 at final handoff (end of week 14); 15-day invoice terms.
- **Reviews:** Hearth returns consolidated comments within five business days at concept (week 6) and detailed design (week 11); one revision round included at each.
- **Contingency:** Up to four days in weeks 15–16, written authorization required, $850 per day, billed only if used, capped at $42,500 total.
- **Extras:** Additional revisions at $900/day with written authorization; supervision under separate agreement.
- **Photos:** Portfolio use of cleared exhibit photos after the first touring venue's public opening; venue approval for venue-identifying shots.

We'll route the agreement for signature this week and issue the deposit within five business days of execution. We'll send the fabricator contact for file-version confirmation at kickoff.

[END]
